summary: A 31-year-old Florida man crashed his motorcycle on Hwy 141 near mile 17 at the top of Slick Rock Canyon near Egnar while traveling alone en route to Boulder, sliding into a guardrail after 9 p.m. Sunday; he walked about 4.5 miles along the road to a small shed near the Dolores River and sheltered there through a blizzard night with temperatures near 17 degrees and winds gusting to 40 mph; found by SAR ~6:47 a.m. Monday with multiple injuries and transported by Dove Creek EMS to Monticello, Colorado.
location: Hwy 141 mm17, Slick Rock Canyon, near Egnar
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office SAR; Egnar Fire and EMS; Dove Creek Ambulance; Colorado State Patrol
notes: Record date = found/search date (Monday 2017-03-06); crash occurred after 9 p.m. Sunday 2017-03-05. 2:30 a.m. call reporting a crashed motorcycle with blood but no driver; ~4-hour multi-agency search in blizzard conditions. He had waited roadside for passersby before walking for shelter. Surfaced via the San Miguel County SO alerts re-check (run 96).
